title: Juice
tagline: Juice is a evm rollapp created using Dymension. Juice also uses Avail as a Data Availability layer
description:
Juice is a evm rollapp created using Dymension. Juice also uses Avail as a Data Availability layer.
Juice is deployed on the Dymension Froopyland testnet and a localnet
Intended to be fork of Aave as a appchain with testnet IBC-transfers already enabled as it's a Dymension rollapp
how_its_made:
Juice was created using the Dymension roller CLI.
Juice is deployed on the Dymension Froopyland testnet and a localnet
Avail was selected as the Data Availability layer. This was done using the Roller CLI provided by Dymension

There were some hiccups along the way but this is described in the video
